### Supported key signaling-test capabilities for Semiconductor applications
- Chipset L1–L4 test-plan execution and verification, including modem stack investigation/debug and 3GPP/carrier device test planning, development, and execution [90].
- Signaling/protocol/application testing mapped to platforms such as R&S CMX500, R&S CMW500, and R&S CMsquares [92].
- RF, signaling, application, OTA, pre-conformance, conformance approval, carrier acceptance, non-signaling RF, signaling protocol, and service/repair test coverage across the 5G device testing value chain from chip vendor through device manufacturer, test house, and network operator [22][23].
- End-to-end performance validation for IMS/SIP/TCP/IP, plus application stack investigation/debug and optimization for defined KPIs [90].
- RF testing capabilities including NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [6].
- Application test capabilities including IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, internal IP services, DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, and Max Throughput Wizard [6][63].
- Automation and workflow capabilities including CMsquares GUI, graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI, SCPI remote control, CMsequencer, and log analysis via CMXmars [6][64].
- Pre-silicon / shift-left protocol testing for chipset development, using a virtual terminal before physical chipset fabrication to find issues early, reduce post-silicon rework, and improve development efficiency [103][104].
- R&D callbox use cases such as new-band verification, sensitivity testing, RedCap, desense testing, 3GPP pre-conformance, SRS measurements, UL MIMO / UL CA RF measurements, UL TX switching, Multi-SIM, high end-to-end throughput, and non-signaling verification [69].
- WLAN/cellular coexistence and desense capability, including WLAN + cellular in one box for interference/desense testing against LTE/NR bands with real connections and parallel LTE + NR + Wi-Fi measurements [17].
- Wi-Fi 7 signaling R&D capabilities, including signaling-mode testing under real-world conditions, RF TX/RX characteristics, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and end-to-end test capabilities [11].
- Manufacturing-related signaling/non-signaling support should focus on high device yield, short test time, RF transceiver characterization/optimization, and debug/trace, with production-related tools including CMP180, CMP200, CMW100, CMX500/CMW500 for signaling, and CMQ [88].

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。

- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。

- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。

- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，具 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality、multiple radio technologies support 與 embedded IP test capabilities。

- Bluetest 引言人物為 [[Kjell Olovsson]]，職稱 Bluetest CEO。

### Supported key signaling-test capabilities for Semiconductor applications
- Chipset L1–L4 test-plan execution and verification, including modem stack investigation/debug and 3GPP/carrier device test planning, development, and execution [90].
- Signaling/protocol/application testing mapped to platforms such as R&S CMX500, R&S CMW500, and R&S CMsquares [92].
- RF, signaling, application, OTA, pre-conformance, conformance approval, carrier acceptance, non-signaling RF, signaling protocol, and service/repair test coverage across the 5G device testing value chain from chip vendor through device manufacturer, test house, and network operator [22][23].
- End-to-end performance validation for IMS/SIP/TCP/IP, plus application stack investigation/debug and optimization for defined KPIs [90].
- RF testing capabilities including NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [6].
- Application test capabilities including IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, internal IP services, DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, and Max Throughput Wizard [6][63].
- Automation and workflow capabilities including CMsquares GUI, graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI, SCPI remote control, CMsequencer, and log analysis via CMXmars [6][64].
- Pre-silicon / shift-left protocol testing for chipset development, using a virtual terminal before physical chipset fabrication to find issues early, reduce post-silicon rework, and improve development efficiency [103][104].
- R&D callbox use cases such as new-band verification, sensitivity testing, RedCap, desense testing, 3GPP pre-conformance, SRS measurements, UL MIMO / UL CA RF measurements, UL TX switching, Multi-SIM, high end-to-end throughput, and non-signaling verification [69].
- WLAN/cellular coexistence and desense capability, including WLAN + cellular in one box for interference/desense testing against LTE/NR bands with real connections and parallel LTE + NR + Wi-Fi measurements [17].
- Wi-Fi 7 signaling R&D capabilities, including signaling-mode testing under real-world conditions, RF TX/RX characteristics, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and end-to-end test capabilities [11].
- Manufacturing-related signaling/non-signaling support should focus on high device yield, short test time, RF transceiver characterization/optimization, and debug/trace, with production-related tools including CMP180, CMP200, CMW100, CMX500/CMW500 for signaling, and CMQ [88].
